$comment: All copy for the banner, featured-work cards and social previews. Edit text here, then run `npm run build`. Image paths are relative to this file; the sibling repos are expected next to this one (../bestdecks, ../slideshow-renderer, ...). Keep volatile numbers (test counts, P&L) off the cards.
author: Nadimul Haque

banner.eyebrow: DATA ENGINEERING  ·  PRODUCT ENGINEERING  ·  NEW YORK
banner.name: Nadimul Haque
banner.headline: Every number traceable to its source.
banner.subline: I build data products end to end, designed to refuse unverified output.

cards.name: bestdecks
cards.line: Drafts a tailored deck per target company, then blocks delivery if any factual claim can't be matched to retained source text.

cards.name: remi-intake-engine
cards.line: Turns memos, rent rolls and email threads into reviewed facts, each linked to the page, cell or message it came from.

cards.name: kalshi-vol-edge
cards.line: Kalshi BTC bracket trading where the exchange is the source of truth, plus post-mortems on what the live data showed.

cards.name: slideshow-renderer
cards.line: A one-line topic becomes validated slide copy as JSON, then a 9:16 video rendered with Remotion.
